title: HTML Tags Standards Dictionary
description: Validation schema for tags.json defining W3C HTML element capabilities and constraints

allowsTextContent.description: Whether this HTML tag allows direct textContent

allowsChildren.description: Whether this HTML tag allows child elements (false for void tags like input, img, hr)

allowedAttributes.description: List of tag-specific HTML attributes allowed on this element

childTags.description: Restricted list of child tags allowed inside this element, or empty if unrestricted
